Indian civic bodies prepare for monsoon, manage waste

Civic bodies in Indian cities are undertaking preparations for the upcoming monsoon season. This includes drafting solid waste management rules, repairing sewers, and desilting drains. Officials are also inspecting areas to ensure readiness for potential challenges.
